title: auth
summary: MSUI implements current Benilla's desktop Windows authentication wire across realmd and the world-session handoff: logon challenge, aligned SRP6 challenge/PIN consumption, proof, proof reply, realm list, CMSG_AUTH_SESSION proof and the real stock secure-addon tail. The challenge's crc_salt rides into CMD_AUTH_LOGON_PROOF and the fixed mangos-family build-5875 Win/x86 integrity digest produces SHA1(A || H), so a default StrictVersionCheck server no longer rejects an otherwise valid login. The world packet now reports the twelve stock Blizzard secure addons as the exact 342-byte record stream behind a nonzero size and RFC1950 zlib instead of the impossible zero-size stub. Focused and full interface checks pass; live strict-realmd and strict classic-world verification remain.

openItems.text: Current Benilla answers realmd's crc_salt integrity challenge, but MSUI discarded crc_salt, sent twenty zero bytes, and required StrictVersionCheck=0.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: retained crc_salt, implemented the Windows build-5875 mangos integrity answer and exact 75-byte proof packet, and removed the disable-StrictVersionCheck guidance. Known-answer, unknown-salt and packet-offset checks pass.

openItems.text: Live verification: authenticate the desktop client against a realmd with StrictVersionCheck enabled and confirm proof acceptance without server configuration changes.
MSUI appended a zero decompressed-size plus zlib-of-empty stub to CMSG_AUTH_SESSION. No real 1.12.1 client emits that shape; VMaNGOS merely ignores it and stricter classic servers reject the session.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: AuthSessionAddonLaw emits the stock client's twelve ASCII-ordered Blizzard secure-addon records (flags 1, standard modulus CRC 0x4C1C776D, URL CRC 0), exact 342-byte plain payload and nonzero size plus RFC1950 zlib. WorldSession appends that tail immediately after the 20-byte proof. Record walk, empty-list law, zlib round-trip, packet-offset and full interface checks pass.

openItems.text: Live-verify CMSG_AUTH_SESSION acceptance and SMSG_ADDON_INFO response against a classic world server that rejects zero-size addon blocks; confirm ordinary VMaNGOS login remains unchanged.
